Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The South Africa Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Nahida Khan and Sidra Ameen who walk out to open for Pakistan Women. Shabnim Ismail to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Now the Pakistan batters have not been at their best so far in the tournament but they need to fire here. The wicket is a decent one to bat on but South Africa have a lot of quality in their bowlers. Can this be chased down? To find out, do join us in a short while for the second essay.

Laura Wolvaardt is in for a chat. She starts by saying that she is upset that she could not keep going. Mentions, they were looking somewhere around 260 plus and now they have to fight hard. Ends by saying Trisha Chetty's knock was a crucial one at the fag end of the innings.

Pakistan were excellent for most parts of this innings. They got early wickets courtesy Sana and even when there was a partnership building they did not let South Africa score freely. They even managed to come back into the game thanks to a magical spell of Ghulam Fatima but the fielding let them down then after, a couple of catches went down and had those been taken, they could have well kept the opposition under 200. They though have ended well coutresy Sana yet agian who was the pick and probably have momentum on their side.

Batting was not easy for South Africa. The new ball swung and they lost two quickly. Laura Wolvaardt along with Sune Luus played brilliantly. They took their own time but got their side to safer shores. Once Laura Wolvaardt fell though, there was a mini collapse. Chloe Tryon and Sune Luus then played really well and added 55 to bail their side out of a tricky position. Trisha Chetty too played a handy cameo towards the end to take her side over the 220-run mark.

A very good recovery from South Africa and they have got themselves to a total which is more than competitive. Pretty sure they would have taken something above 220 when they were 120 for 5. Pakistan on the other hand, have yet again failed to capitalize after being in a good position. They have no one but themselves to be blamed as they created chances but did not take it. They now face a stiff task ahead as this is not going to be easy to chase.

OUT! TIMBER! Fatima Sana picks her up third wicket and ends the innings on a high for Pakistan Women. It is yorker, right in the blockhole. Trisha Chetty tries to dig it out but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. South Africa Women end their innings at 223/9.
Full length, on off. Masabata Klaas whips it through mid-wicket for one.

OUT! RUN OUT! South Africa Women lose their eighth wicket. A length ball, on middle and leg. Shabnim Ismail tucks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. There is an overthrow and the batters opt to run one more. Although, Sidra Ameen does well with the back up and throws the ball to the keeper who clips the bails off to see Shabnim Ismail short of the crease. Masabata Klaas is the new batter in.
Full length, on off. Chetty drills it to long on for one.

Overthrow! A length ball, outside off. Chetty slashes it to point and takes off for a quick single. The fielder misses her attempt at the non-striker's end, but there is no back up as well. This allows the batters to take one more.
A dot to start the final over! Slower one, full length, just outside off. Trisha Chetty looks to heave it away but misses.
Full and on off. Ismail pushes it to cover. 8 runs off it. Can South Africa Women end on a high?
Fuller, on middle. Trisha Chetty comes down the track but this time hits it a little hard towards long on. They only get a single this time.
Full and on the pads. Trisha Chetty eases it to mid on. The fielder is placed in the deep and hence the batters push hard and take two with ease.
FOUR! Gets lucky enough to see the ball scoop past her stumps. Tossed up, around middle and leg. Trisha Chetty premeditates a reverse-sweep and works it past the keeper for a boundary at third man.
Floated and on the pads. Ismail flicks it to square leg for a quick single.
Short and outside off. Shabnim Ismail cuts it hard to cover but staright to the fielder.
A dot to end! Full and on off, this is pushed to mid off. A really good over from Sana comes to an end.
Outside off, Ismail hits it through covers for one.
A yorker on middle, Ismail jams it out towards point.
Shabnim Ismail is the new batter in.
Review! Sune Luus takes a review for lbw. The on-field decision is OUT. The UltraEdge show no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows the wickets are hitting and the on-field decision stands.

OUT! THAT IS DEAD PLUMB! This time the review does not save her! An excellent innings from Luus comes to an end. This is full and on middle, Luus looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad in front. A huge appeal and the finger is raised. Luus reviews but replays show she has to walk back and take a review along. Can Pakistan now keep South Africa under 225?
Angled into the pads, Chetty works it through square leg for one.
Just a single off the Free Hit! What a beautiful shot only for one. Fuller and on off, Luus lifts it over mid off for a single to long off.
Two more! It is also a no ball. Pakistan are giving it away here. On middle, this is heaved over mid-wicket for a couple.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! Far too many drops by Pakistan in the second half of this innings and that has proved costly. This probably came back a lot slower than Dar expected! Outside off, Chetty reaches out for it and looks to hit it down the ground. It goes off the toe-end back to Dar who spills it.
Two! Deft! Clever stuff again! Outside off, Chetty uses the pace and guides it past short third man for two.
Gets the biggie on the last ball, now pushes it through cover for one.
SIX! Bang! That sails over the fence! What a shot that is from Luus. 11 from the first three balls then. On middle, Luus moves across and then heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Good batting! On off, Trisha Chetty plays it towards point for one.
FOUR! That is clever batting and this is a good little innings from Chetty. She brings out the paddle scoop, it is played fine on the leg side for a boundary. Good start to the over.
A yorker to end then! On middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Now waits for the slower one and then guides it down to third man for one.
Good comeback! Length and on off, Chetty guides it to point.
FOUR! Up and over! That is a good shot from Chetty. Fatima Sana goes short and on middle, Chetty goes down on one knee and slams it over mid on.
On middle, Trisha Chetty clips it through mid-wicket for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Excellent running! On off, this is worked wide of long on. They take two. Excellent running.
Outside off, Luus plays it towards cover for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air and outside off, Chetty looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Flatter and on off, Trisha looks to drop and run but is sent back.
Another single to end! Fuller and on off, Trisha Chetty eases it past the dive of the bowler for another run.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Trisha Chetty is off the mark as she plays this full ball down to long on for one.
On middle, defended.
Trisha Chetty comes in at number 8.

OUT! TAKEN! Tryon departs and she is livid with herself! That is a soft dismissal and a welcome one. These two were taking South Africa into a strong position. Lovely delivery by Sandhu. Tosses it up, Tryon steps out, this dips right at the end. Chloe Tryon chips it back to the left of the bowler who takes it. Can Pakistan now make quick work of the lower-order?
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
A dot to end, so despite the biggie, only 8 from the over. On off, this is pushed to covers.

SIX! That has sailed over the fence. Brute of a stroke and the 50-run stand is up! A really good partnership and a much-needed one for the batting side. Can the two take South Africa over the 220 run mark now? Tryon steps out, gets to the pitch of it and slams it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Yet another dot! Quicker and fuller, this is played back to the bowler.
Another single only! Outside off, Luus strokes it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, defended.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Nida Dar (5-0-14-0) is back into the attack.
Around off, this is pushed to cover. A really good over then by Sandhu.
Short again and outside off, Tryon cuts but through point for one.
Shorter and outside off, Luus hits it through covers for one.
On off, Luus pushes it to covers. Another dot.
WIDE! That is well wide outside off, wided.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, left alone.
A huge shout but it is going down leg! On the pads, Tryon looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Two more! Angled into the pads, Tryon works it through square leg. Two taken.

DROPPED! Another chance goes down. Tough one but could have been taken! Length and outside off, Tryon pushes at it, it goes off the outside edge, the keeper dives to her right, stretches one hand out but does not stick in. It goes behind. The fielder from third man is slow to come in, two taken.
Outside off, Luus goes after it, it goes off the toe-end down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Comes down the track again, once again she drags it from outside off but towards long on for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! That is hit powerfully! This is tossed up well wide outside off, Tryon comes down the track, she does not get to the pitch of it but still manages to drag it wide of mid-wicket for a boundary.
Singles are coming easily. On off, Luus guides it through point for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter again and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
Shorter and outside off, Tryon guides it to point.
Tryon steps out, the length is shortened, it is defended.
WIDE! This is quite wide outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, Luus pushes it through covers for one.
Tryon comes down the track and hits it down to long on for one.
A single as this is hit towards sweeper cover. Singles coming frequently for South Africa.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.

NOT OUT! There is yet another inside edge! Ultra Edge confirms that. This pitches around leg. Luus looks to sweep but seems to have missed it. It hits the pad and goes towards the leg side. A run is taken. Pakistan review. Ultra Edge shows a spike. Pakistan lose a review. However, the umpire signals a leg bye. Not sure why!
Another review from Pakistan as another loud shout for LBW has been turned down. Sune Luus is the batter yet again. This though has probably pitched outside leg.
Tryon steps down the track and strokes it back towards the bowler. She misfields and a run is taken.
This time she punches it past the cover fielder and a single is taken.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
A single as this is hit through covers again. A good over for South Africa.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

NOT OUT! Impact is umpire's call! It just seems like it is Luus' day! This could have gone either way but it goes her way. Pakistan can't believe it. This lands outside off, turns back in. Luus looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. It is reviewed. Replays show that the on-field call stays.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down. The impact seems outside off.
FOUR! Nice and fine and that is a welcome boundary! On the pads, Luus plays the sweep, she gets it nice and fine and to the fine leg fence.
Tossed up on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Tryon pushes it through covers for one.

DRINKS! South Africa Women were cruising after losing two early wickets. The stand between Sune Luus and Laura Wolvaardt almost took the game away from Pakistan Women. But it is Ghulam Fatima who got her side back into the game with her magic arm. She picked up three wickets in quick succession and Pakistan Women now have a real opportunity to restrict South Africa Women to a below-par score. An interesting passage of play awaits.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off. The fielder at cover, runs to her right, dives and stops it.
Outside off, Tryan stays back and hits it through covers for one.
The broom is out again! On middle, this is swept through square leg for one more.
This time she finds the gap through the cover region and a run is taken.
That turned! Shorter and outside off, this spins away. Tryon slaps it to covers.
Tossed up on middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Full, wide outside off, just inside the tramline. Chloe Tryon leaves it alone for the keeper. A good over by Nashra Sandhu.
Full, on middle and leg. Chloe Tryon blocks it to mid on.
Floated, full and on off, blocked out.
Full, on the pads. Sune Luus flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, wide outside off. Sune Luus leaves it alone. It is not a wide, as it was just inside the tramline.
Flatter, just outside off. Chloe Tryon pushes it to cover for one.
On off, Chloe Tryon taps it to point for one.

DROPPED! Slower through the air, full and outside off. Chloe Tryon shuffles across and hit it flat, across the line towards mid on. The fielder there comes forward but is unable to gather the ball safely.
Another single now as this worked towards mid off.
Tossed up, full and on off. Chloe Tryon comes down the track and pushes it to mid off for a single.
Around off, Luus pushes it to cover for a single.
On the stumps, defended out solidly.
On middle and leg. Sune Luus flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Floated, on off. Sune Luus defends it out.
Length ball, on off. Chloe Tryon punches it to cover. The fielder fumbles and the batters cross for one.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
Short, outside off. Chloe Tryon cuts it to point.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
Chloe Tryon is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Marizanne Kapp is disappointed with herself as she holes out on a full toss delivery. Ghulam Fatima gets her third wicket. What a game she is having at the moment. It is full toss, on off. Marizanne Kapp gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg. Sidra Ameen runs in front of her to reach the ball. She gets low but gathers the ball as she is rolling on the ground. That is some catching!
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Ameen b Ghulam Fatima

Commentary.Commentary: On off, blocked out.
Darted, on the pads. Marizanne Kapp flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple. This was a risky second run. Sidra Nawaz does well to chase the ball but is unable to score a direct hit.
FOUR! Marizanne Kapp gets her first boundary of the innings. Showing good intent. Short and outside off. Marizanne Kapp waits for it and steers it through backward point for one.
Flighted, full and on the stumps. Sune Luus works it to long on for a single.
Full, down leg. Sune Luus sweeps it to fine leg for a brace.
Angled into the pads, Kapp hangs back and works it to mid-wicket.
5 now! On off, blocked.
Tossed up on off, defended. 4 dots in a row.
Another one on the shorter side, Kapp plays it to point.
Another dot! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Marizanne Kapp is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in the over now and Pakistan Women are back in the game. Slower through the air, outside off, on a length. Mignon du Preez stays on the back foot and tries to cut it away but she gets beaten by the turn and bounce. It flies towards backward point off the bottom half of the blade. Omaima Sohail dives forward and takes a sharp catch. Ghulam Fatima gets her side back in the contest.
Commentary.Howout: c Omaima Sohail b Ghulam Fatima

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, Mignon du Preez pushes it to cover.
Full and on off. Mignon du Preez pushes it to mid off.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Ghulam Fatima strikes and breaks the partnership. Sidra Nawaz runs towards the bowler and hugs her in joy. Pakistan Women really needed this wicket. It is looped up, on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt tries to flick it away but only finds a leading edge. It flies back towards the bowler. Ghulam Fatima then dives in front of her to pouch the ball safely. Mignon du Preez is the new batter in.

FOUR! Laura Wolvaardt dealing mostly in boundaries now. It is full toss and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt comes down the track and puts it away into the wide long off boundary. She moves to 75. This is also her best World Cup score.
Full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt eases it down to long on for a single. 6 runs off it. This stand is starting to hurt Pakistan Women now.
Length ball, on off, defended out watchfully.
FOUR! Laura Wolvaardt is motoring along really well here. Full length, on the pads. Laura Wolvaardt flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Laura Wolvaardt defends it out solidly.

LEG BYE! A length ball, around off, nips in off the deck. Sune Luus makes room and tries to flick it away but misses. She gets pinged on her pads. Fatima Sana appeals but the umpire is not interested. This is surely going down leg. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Full length, outside off. Sune Luus pushes it to point.
Floated, full and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt prods and tries to drive it away, it comes off the outer half though.
Short and on off. Sune Luus cuts it to the off side. Not in the gap.
A single now as this is worked towards mid off.
Just over! Loopy ball, full and on off. Sune Luus chips it over the bowler's head. Ghulam Fatima leaps but could not pouch the ball. They take one.
A single as this is pushed to cover.
Full and outside off. Sune Luus drives it to mid off.
A single as this is worked towards mid on. A miscalculation here.

Sune Luus gets pinged on her pads and the umpire raises the dreaded finger, There is delight amongst the Pakistan Women players but Sune Luus decides to take the review. The UltraEdge shows there is a clear spike as the ball passes the blade. Sune Luus survives yet again.
On the pads, Laura Wolvaardt tucks it to fine leg for one.
Tossed up, full, on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for two runs.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! A very poor delivery and Laura Wolvaardt makes the most of it. Full and down leg. Laura Wolvaardt sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary.
Full, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to mid off.
On middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt eases it to mid on for one.
FOUR! And again! Laura Wolvaardt is on a roll now. Floated, full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt dances down the track and hoicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! Good use of the feet and FIFTY up for Laura Wolvaardt. Tossed up, full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it across the line past mid on for a boundary.
Full, on middle and leg. Sune Luus sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full toss, on off. Sune Luus tries to heave it away. It takes the inside edge and moves to the left of the keeper.
Flighted, full and down leg. Sune Luus tries to chase it but misses. She gets some blade on it but the keeper does well to cover.
On off, blocked out.
Short and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to point off the back foot.
Short and on off. Sune Luus cuts it through covers for one.
Floated, full, angled down leg. Sune Luus tries to sweep it away but misses.

Loopy ball, outside off. Sune Luus gets on one knee but misses her sweep attempt. She get hit on her pads and Omaima Sohail puts in a loud appeal. The umpire is unmoved. Looks like the impact it outside the line.
On off, blocked out.
Shouts of catch! It is fuller, on off. Sune Luus gets underneath and lofts it over mid off but she could not middle it to send it all the way. Although it lands safely and they take one.
Full, outside off. Sune Luus shuffles across and eases it to mid off.
Fuller and on the stumps. Laura Wolvaardt leans in and drives it to mid off for another single.
Tossed up, on off. Sune Luus pushes it to mid off for one.
Darted into the pads. Laura Wolvaardt stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Looped up, outside off, turning away. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to cover on the back foot.
Around off, defended to mid on.
Loopy ball, on off. Sune Luus defends it out watchfully.
A single as this is pushed towards mid on.
Short and on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to the off side.
Floated, full, on middle and leg. Sune Luus drills it down to long on for one. The stand moves to 50.
Tossed up, full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt taps it to point for one.
Full and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it into cover for one.
On off, worked towards mid off.
Full, on leg. Sune Luus clips it to fine leg for one.
Another dot as Luus hit a full delivery towards cover but straight to the fielder.
Fuller, outside off. Luus drives it to cover.
WOAH! Looped up, around off. Sune Luus chips it to the left of the bowler. Luckily it lands safely and is far away from danger.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt defends i to mid on.
A single now as this is pushed to cover.
Tossed up, on off. Laura Wolvaardt hits it down the ground for one.
Full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to point.
Slower through the air, outside off, and moves away with the arm. Laura Wolvaardt reads it wrong and leans it to defend it out but luckily for her, it zips past her outside edge.
Floated, on off. Luus remains solid in her defense.
Tossed up, on off. Sune Luus presses forward and defends it into the deck.
Looped up, around off. Luus blocks it out.
On off, pushed to covers.
Floated, full and on off. Sune Luus gets under it and lofts it over the bowler's head towards long off for a brace. She gets it off the toe-end.
On leg, defended to mid-wicket.
Short and around off. Laura Wolvaardt makes room and cuts it to point.
Tossed up, full and on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to mid off.
Full, on middle. Sune Luus drills it to long on for one.
On the stumps, blocked out solidly.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Sune Luus flicks it to short mid-wicket.
A single now as this is worked towards mid on.
Short and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt slashes it hard to sweeper cover for one.
on off, blocked out.
Outside off, pushed to cover for one.
Short, outside off, cut hard to covers.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to cover for one more.
Fuller, on leg. Laura Wolvaardt flicks it to fine leg for a brace.
On off, blocked out.
Review! Sune Luus opts to take the review. The on-field decision is OUT. The UltraEdge though shows there is a spike as the ball passes the blade. The final decision is NOT OUT.

NOT OUT! Sune Luus makes the most of the review. She survives. Loopy ball, around off, turning in a hint. Sune Luus gets low and tries to sweep it away but misses. She gets pinged on her pads. Nida Dar appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Sune Luus was about to walk off the field but eventually decides to have a chat with her partner. She takes the review and it shows there is some bat on it. She remains on the crease.
Fuller, on the stumps. Sune Luus defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, just outside off. Laura Wolvaardt shuffles across and flicks it towards mid on for one.
Fuller, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to cover on the front foot.
On off, blocked out.

DRINKS! Pakistan Women started on a positive now. They picked up two wickets inside the Powerplay. But are finding it difficult to keep the third-wicket stand in check. South Africa Women need Sune Luus and Laura Wolvaardt to bat for long and put on a respectable total.

Four dots on the trot to end the over! This is also lands just short of the fielder. Could've been curtains for Sune Luus. Touch short and outside off. Sune Luus cuts it towards point but it does not carry.
Looped up, on off. Luus blocks it out.
Full, on off, pushed to covers.
Full, on leg. Luus clips it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely played! Sune Luus growing in confidence now. Floated, full, down leg. Sune Luus gets low and sweeps it towards fine leg and bags a boundary. The fielder in the deep makes a mess of it.
Short and outside off. Luus cuts it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Tossed up, on off. Laura Wolvaardt defends it to mid off.
Full, on middle. Luus eases it to mid on for one more.
A single as this is worked to mid on.
Full and angled down leg. Sune Luus tucks it to fine leg. The batters take three with ease.
Quicker and fuller this time, on leg. Laura Wolvaardt goes inside the crease and flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Flighted, full, on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full, on middle. Sune Luus flicks it towards mid on.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it into covers for another single.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller, angled down leg. Sune Luus gets on one knee and sweeps it to fine leg from down leg. They take one.
Yorker, in the blockhole. Sune Luus digs it out sharply.
Floated, full, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt leans in and drives it through covers for one.
Just 2 runs off the over! Tossed up, on off. Sune Luus blocks it towards mid on.
Fuller, on the stumps. Luus defends it out solidly.
A single as this is flicked towards mid on.
Flighted, fuller and on off. Laura Wolvaardt goes on the back foot to push it to mid off.
On a length, around leg. Laura Wolvaardt tucks it to mid-wicket.
Looped up, on off. Luus pushes it out for a single.
Full length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to cover on the front foot. Diana Baig could not maintain the same pressure as she would've liked too.

FOUR! Finds the gap yet again and bags another boundary. It is short again but wide outside off. Laura Wolvaardt gets on top of the bounce and cuts it hard through point. The ball races away to the fence.

FOUR! This should release some pressure for South Africa Women. Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Laura Wolvaardt picks up the length very early.
Full length, on off, pushed to cover.
Baig goes fuller again. Laura Wolvaardt presses forward and defends it to mid off. Sidra Nawaz is happy with this line and length and appreciates the bowler as well from behind the stumps.
Full length, on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt defends it to the off side.
Slower through the air. Luus clips it towards mid on. A tidy start for Nida Dar with the ball.
Slightly short, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it hard through covers for one more.
Fuller, wide outside off. Luus pushes it to sweeper cover for one.
Quicker and flatter, outside off. Luus plays it late and slashes it to point.
Flighted, full and on off. Luus defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on off. Laura Wolvaardt eases it to mid on for one.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner ring until the end of the 40th over.
A single then as this is hit through covers.
Fuller and on off, Luss drives through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Luus misses out! Shorter and outside off, Luss cuts but to cover-point.
Shorter and outside off, Laura this time hits it hard through point but to the fielder in the deep for one.
Fumble but no run taken. Shorter and outside off, this is cut hard towards point.
Well fielded! Pakistan are up for this. Fuller and on middle, this is driven nicely towards mid on. The fielder dives to her left and stops it. Saves three for her side.
Fails to find the gap! Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
Length again, kept out.
On middle, Laura pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Wonderfully put away. On middle, fuller. This is clipped stilyishly through mid-wicket and it races away.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
On off, kept out.
Sune Luus comes in at number 4.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is a stunner. What a catch. Brilliant. Brits' struggle in the middle ends. South Africa in trouble. Lovely nut. Length and on off, this one shapes away. Brits pushes at it. It goes off the outside edge to the right of the keeper, Sidra Nawaz who dives to that side, sticks a hand out and the ball stays in. Pakistan are elated.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Nawaz b Diana Baig

Commentary.Commentary: Just outside off, left alone.
Corrects her line and bowls it on middle, kept out.
Outside off, slightly shorter. Brits slashes but misses. She missed out there. That was there to be put away.
A dot to end! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Finally a run for Tazmin. On middle, this is clipped through square leg for one.

Direct hit and that would have been another wicket. The lack of runs made them go for that single. Outside off, this is played to point. The batters go for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On middle again, this is worked to mid-wicket. The pressure continues to build.
On middle, Laura clips it to mid-wicket.
And again, tidy stuff! Length and on off, blocked.
A fuller delivery to end! Brits strokes it back to the bowler. Brits finding it tough to even score a single st the moment and Pakistan are giving away nothing.
Yet another dot! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Tazmin pushes it to covers. Pressure building on Brits.
Shorter and outside off, Tazmin has a go at it but is beaten.
That is a beautiful shot but only for one. Outside off, fuller, this is creamed through covers, there is a fielder in the deep so only one.
Good length and around off, Laura guides it to point.
Attacks the stumps again. Brits gets right behind the line and defends.
Another dot! Tidy stuff. On a length and around off, blocked.
Crisp but to the man! Shorter and on off, Brits pushes it to mid off.
On the stumps again, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, kept out well.
Outside off, Tazmin leaves it alone.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
Slightly shorter and on middle, defended.
A single now! Fuller again and outside off. Laura yet again unleashes the stunnng drive but towards cover who fumbles and a run is taken.
FOUR! Caressed! It is a pleasure to watch Laura play the cover drive. Fuller and outside off. Laura drives it wonderfully through covers for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

That is a really good effort in the field. Two from the Free Hit. This is full and wide outside off. Laura carves it over point. The fielder at third man runs to her right, dives and saves two for her side.
Outside off, Laura guides it to point. No ball and that is a Free Hit coming up.
Beaten! A beauty to end! Length and outside off, Brits pushes at it away from her body but is beaten. She was worried about the ball coming back in.
Outside off, left alone.
Tazmin Brits is the new batter.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is a huge blow as the dangerous Lee departs. An early wicket for Pakistan. Exactly what they would have wanted. They could have easily had two had the catch been taken on the last. Nevertheless, they will be pleased. Length and on off, shaping away. Lee pushes at it with hare hands. It goes off the outside edge and it is taken by the keeper with a dive to her right.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Nawaz b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Put down! That was a big chance. Not the easiest but you need to take these. Fuller and on outside off. Laura drives, it goes off the outside edge towards gully. It bursts through the hands of Nida Dar ans goes down to third man for one. This can prove costly.
Solid! Really good stuff from Pakistan so far. Another one on off, length. Kept out.
On off, defended nicely.
Good length and on off, Lee pushes it to covers.
Lee is off the mark with a couple! On off, this is pushed through covers for two.
Good line and length. Just outside off and on a length. Swinging away. Left alone.
Yet another a little too straight. Clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle, gets it to move away a little. This is worked to mid-wicket.
Starts off with one around off, shaking away. This is guided to gully.
Who will bowl from the other end? Diana Baig it is.
A delivery wide of the off pole to end, left alone. A good start for the batting side then.
Good length and on off, blocked.
FOUR! Just wide and Laura Wolvaardt is off the mark in style. Fuller and outside off, Laura drives uppishly but wide of the fielder and point for a boundary.
On off, Laura blocks.
Well bowled! Closer to the off pole. Laura is worried about the ball coming back in. This goes on with the angle. Laura has a poke at it and is beaten.
This time gets it to start from well outside off but no swing. Left alone.

TWO WIDES! South Africa are underway! A wayward start by Sana but that swung a long way. This starts on middle and swings in a long way. Left alone. The keeper fails to take it cleanly and a run is taken.

Done with all the pre-match proceedings. Pakistan Women players are seen to be in a huddle, before they spread out to their respective fielding positions. Followed by Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt who walk out to open for South Africa Women. Before the first ball being bowled, the South Africa Women players take the knee while Pakistan Women pay respects by standing tall and support the BLM movement. Fatima Sana to start with the new ball.
We are set for the clash. Both the teams stride out to the field and get lined-up for the national anthems. It will be South Africa's first. Followed by the one of Pakistan's.
PITCH REPORT - Naseer Hussain says we have moved two strips down that means the dimensions have changed. Lisa joins the chat and says the deck is greener.
Sune Luus, South Africa Women captain, is in for a chat. She says they are happy to bat first. Adds they have a single change to their side as well.

Bismah Maroof, the Pakistan skipper, is in for a chat. She says they would love to bowl first. Mentions they will try to restrict them to a lower total. Adds she has play South Africa several times and this should be a great contest.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee (In for Lara Goodall), Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas, Ayabonga Khaka.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Sidra Ameen, Nahida Khan, Bismah Maroof (C), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Diana Baig, Sidra Nawaz (WK), Nashra Sandhu, Ghulam Fatima (In for Anam Amin).
TOSS - Pakistan Women win the toss and they will bowl first.

Especially against Pakistan who will be hungry for their first win of the tournament. They were beaten heavily in their opener against India and then were brushed away by the Aussies. Can they cause an upset and get the better of a strong South African unit?

South Africa have just played the one game so far and won it quite easily against another Asian side Bangladesh. They are favourites to make it 2 in 2 with a win here but nothing can be taken for granted.
The Women's T20 World Cup is moving along nicely and we welcome you to the coverage of yet another game. It is a clash between South Africa and Pakistan.
